message: 友達
After the Holy Night Festival ended--

name: Azel
message: 「Nanaka did all of this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」
Azel stared at the exhibition of the photos she had taken for a while.

name: Azel
message: 「...It's embarrassing.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so? It got great reviews.」

name: Azel
message: 「I should have been able to take better photos.」

name: Azel
message: 「If I'd had the time, I could have used my Leica instead of a digital camera...」

name: Azel
message: 「Besides, I didn't help prepare the exhibit at all. I ended up leaving everything to her.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Azel
message: 「...If it were me, I wouldn't have been able to arrange them like this.」

name: Azel
message: 「I would have hesitated too much.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it's because they aren't her own photos? Besides--」
Because Nanaka is decisive.
I almost said it out loud, then swallowed the words.
That wasn't all there was to her.
Nanaka was more timid than I had thought.
Unable to voice her feelings for me, she had kept them hidden deep in her heart.
And I myself was denser than I had realized.
If it hadn't been for what happened this time, I might not have even noticed Nanaka's feelings.

name: Azel
message: 「I've done nothing... but cause trouble for Nanaka.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Me too...」

name: Azel
message: 「Just how long has Nanaka been in love with you, I wonder?」

name: Azel
message: 「And yet, I showed up out of nowhere and ended up like this with you, Synn.」

name: Azel
message: 「While she was putting up these panels... how must she have felt?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka is... the best friend anyone could ask for.」

name: Azel
message: 「I wish we could have walked side by side. If we had, we probably could have talked about a lot of things」

name: Synn
message: 「You can just talk to her from now on」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you think... I could become friends with Nanaka?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka already thinks of you as a friend, Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「If you go asking to be friends now, she'll either laugh at you or get mad」

name: Azel
message: 「...You're right」

name: Synn
message: 「And it's not just Nanaka--Ria-senpai, Misa, Lolotte, Sally-chan, Sacchin, and Eddie all think of you as a friend too」

name: Azel
message: 「I see... So I was the only one who thought I was alone」
